entities.summary: Jeton Neziraj is a playwright from Kosovo. He was the Artistic Director of the National Theatre of Kosovo and now he is the Director of Qendra Multimedia, a cultural production company based in Prishtina. Jeton Neziraj was a poets & playwrights from Kaçanik (b. 1977, Kaçanik). Its legacy: Contributed poetry and drama to cultural canon.
